summary: Auddia Inc., a Nasdaq-listed Delaware company, held a special meeting on September 23, 2026 to vote on its merger with McCarthy Finney, Inc./Thramann Holdings, LLC under a February 17, 2026 merger agreement via Holdco and two merger subs. Only 2,654,364 shares were represented, and proxies were insufficient to approve the Business Combination Proposal; stockholders instead approved adjournment 2,238,335 to 343,919 with 72,110 abstaining, and the meeting was adjourned without opening the polls. Watch the reconvened vote, proxy solicitation progress, and any Nasdaq/regulatory clock risk.
